summary.text: Chriselle Martinez is the Democratic candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 57, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small business owner with a doctorate from the University of New Mexico, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is focused on lowering costs and strengthening health care and education.

paragraphs.text: Chriselle Martinez earned a Ph.D. from the University of New Mexico in 2021 and works as a business owner.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her doctorate is in Counselor Education and that she spent more than a decade working in higher education and community development, including work with credit unions and local partners.
She said she now runs a coaching and consulting business and is a mother of two.
Martinez advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.

She said her priorities include recruiting and retaining doctors, nurses, therapists and behavioral health providers, lowering prescription drug costs, and expanding behavioral health and addiction treatment.
